method.title: Coverage & methodology
method.empty: Coverage will appear when the selected window returns drives.
method.capped: The request returned {{limit}} rows, so this describes the observed selected-window subset; additional drives in the date range may not be represented.
method.window: This describes all {{count}} rows returned for the selected window, up to the {{limit}}-row API limit.
method.eligibility: Eligibility requires positive measured energy and average speed, at least {{distance}} km, and at least {{minutes}} minutes.
method.buckets: Whole-drive average speed is grouped into {{width}} km/h half-open bands; at least {{count}} drives qualify a band.
method.weighting: Band, monthly, and overall consumption use total energy ÷ total distance, not an average of drive-level ratios.
method.monthly: Monthly average speed is total eligible distance ÷ total eligible duration. Drives with malformed dates stay in non-calendar aggregates.
method.scatter: The scatter shows at most {{limit}} evenly spaced chronological points, including the endpoints; all eligible drives feed every aggregate.
method.scope: This is whole-drive average-speed evidence, not instantaneous cruising speed and not a recommended road speed.
method.confounders: Route, weather, elevation, HVAC, traffic, and trip length can confound the association. The observed gap is descriptive, not causal and not a savings forecast.

brief.provenance: Distance-weighted eligible returned drives; sample floor and row cap are unchanged.
